crossRefs.note: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.
His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.

translations.web: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.
translations.bsb: Nothing on earth is his equal— a creature devoid of fear!
translations.kjv: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
translations.asv: Upon earth there is not his like, That is made without fear.
